description: Defines constants, structures, enums, and flags related to NTLM protocol messages, including SecurityBuffer, NtlmFeatures, MessageType, NegotiateFlags, TargetInfoAvId, TargetInfoAvFlags, and AvPair.

classes.name: SecurityBuffer
classes.description: Represents a security buffer structure within an NTLM message, indicating payload offset and length.

classes.name: NtlmFeatures
classes.description: Encapsulates features enabled in NTLM, such as NTLMv2, MIC, and EPA.

classes.name: AvPair
classes.description: Represents an Attribute-Value pair used in NTLM target info, containing an identifier, payload, flags, and timestamp.

methods.name: SecurityBuffer()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing offset and length to zero.

methods.name: SecurityBuffer(uint32_t offset, uint16_t length)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with specific offset and length.

methods.name: NtlmFeatures(bool enable_NTLMv2)
methods.description: Constructor to set NTLMv2 feature flag.

methods.name: AvPair(TargetInfoAvId avid, uint16_t avlen)
methods.description: Constructor with AV ID and length.

methods.name: AvPair(TargetInfoAvId avid, std::vector<uint8_t> buffer)
methods.description: Constructor with AV ID and payload buffer.
